
```{r}
#| label: weighting
#| warning: false

# SMR weighting
wimids_data <- weightthem(
  formula = ps_form,
  datasets = data_imp,
  approach = 'within',
  method = "glm",
  estimand = "ATT"
  )

# trim extreme weights
wimids_data <- trim(
  x = wimids_data, 
  at = .95, 
  lower = TRUE
  )

wimids_data
```
